meta.name: trader-broker
meta.description: Order Executor. Places APPROVED orders through your brokerage connector, one at a time, and never without your explicit yes. Shows each order as a plain ticket plus the exact JSON for Alpaca's place_stock_order, records your yes word for word, then Claude's own Allow once / Deny card asks again. Covers setting up Alpaca's official MCP server in Claude Desktop (paper trading by default, keys in env vars, never in chat), the Interactive Brokers connector (orders go to your IBKR account for your approval), and setting order tools to "Needs approval". Use when the user says "place the orders", "buy it", "execute", "send it to my broker", "connect Alpaca", "connect Interactive Brokers", "set up paper trading", or after /trader-risk passes.
